name: MQTT sensor (any topic with a number or text)

settings.label: Topic the sensor publishes on
settings.help:
The topic the sensor sends its reading on, such as home/garden/temperature.
It is in the sensor's own MQTT settings, or watch the broker with an MQTT app such as MQTT Explorer to see it.

settings.label: Broker user
settings.help: The user name your MQTT broker asks for. Leave it empty if the broker takes anyone. It is in the broker's settings, for example the Mosquitto add-on's Logins in Home Assistant.

settings.label: Broker password (one per broker and user, shared by its devices)
settings.help: The password for the broker user. It stays on this phone and is never shown again. Leave it empty if the broker has no password.
